**Registration for the 2026 Northeast Institutional Repository Day (NIRD26) is now open!

When: Thursday, December 3, 2026 - 1:00pm - 5:00pm Eastern AND Friday, December 4, 2026 - 11am - 2:00pm Eastern 

Virtual Conference

  • Where: Zoom (link provided after registration).  Each day of NIRD26 will have a unique registration link.

  • The draft schedule is posted on our website and can also be found using this tinyurl: http://z.umn.edu/nird26program.

  • Registration is free http://z.umn.edu/nird26program and the registration forms can be found here: Day 1 (Dec. 3) and Day 2 (Dec. 4).

By registering for NIRD, you are agreeing to abide by the NIRD Code of Conduct.

For Zoom registration questions, please contact Emily P. O’Brien (epobrien@wpi.edu).  

We hope to see you there!

NIRD26 Planning and Program Committee

nird@groups.io**
